name: verify_playable_ad
description: Tier-0 static boot-smoke of a self-contained playable-ad index.html (faithful port of engines/web smoke.py): exactly one <canvas>, no external/remote resources, no forbidden network/storage/eval APIs, the window.__smokeReady hook, and a best-effort JS syntax parse. Returns ok=false with concrete problems to feed a repair. Passing means the game is ELIGIBLE for the engines/web freeform genre; it is a static gate, not proof the game boots at runtime (that is a Tier-1 headless probe).

html_path.description: Sandbox-relative path to the game's index.html
